effect_description_eng:
[On Play] Play 1 purple or yellow Digimon with 6000 DP or less from your trash without paying its memory cost. If your have 1 or fewer security cards, you may play 1 level 6 or lower Digimon card with the [Angel] or [Fallen Angel] trait from your trash without paying its memory cost instead.
[End of Your Turn] This Digimon and any of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
